resources.name: Quantum ESPRESSO (open-source plane-wave DFT code) or equivalent

access.notes: Any plane-wave DFT implementation supporting LDA and finite-displacement phonons may be used (e.g., Quantum ESPRESSO is the open-source fallback).

resources.name: SSSP efficiency pseudopotentials for Ge and N (or equivalent library)

access.notes: Ultrasoft or PAW pseudopotentials in LDA approximation suitable for Ge and N. The agent must choose adequate pseudopotentials; the tolerances absorb small differences due to pseudopotential choice.
If the DFT code does not provide built-in phonon extraction, Phonopy can be used to generate displacements and compute force constants.
